scope: Fresh oracle author BEFORE oracle/harness freeze; this is an allowlist contract, not an OS sandbox or a proof of enforced isolation.
allowed_tools: Only coordinator-declared tools restricted to this copied aperture and author-owned outputs. No browser, GitHub connector, broad shell/filesystem access, shared transcript or parent context that exposes forbidden material.
forbidden_information_classes: committed or owner tests and fixtures
local pause review and raw-material index
coordinator prompt, README and broader chat
additional_interfaces: Only declaration-only interface contracts, separately pinned and added to this manifest BEFORE authoring. No silent implementation exposure.
enforcement_receipt_required: exact copied file inventory with SHA-256
if_not_enforceable: Do source-exposed developer qualification only; independent gate remains open.
postfreeze: Executor/reviewer may read source, owner controls and postfreeze materials only after preserving the oracle/apparatus freeze; never backdate or silently repair the frozen subject.
